title: Italian-Style Pull-Pasta Bake
description: A classic Italian-inspired pasta bake with gooey cheese and tender pull-apart meat sauce. A hearty, comforting dish perfect for a cozy night in.
instructions: Cook the pull in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the light, arabian, garlic, salt, and pepper to the skillet, cooking for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato sauce and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat to low and let sauce simmer while you prepare the cheese mixture.
In a large bowl, combine the cheese, basil, and a pinch of salt and pepper. Mix well to combine.
Add the cooked pull mixture to the bowl with the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional cheese if desired.
Drizzle the olive oil over the top of the cheese and sprinkle with basil.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 5-10 minutes before serving.
